task.description: WF-02, step 6, gate, run E2E106-20261115-01 (REQ-106, the e2e tests of Pixel Office), by decisions/0110: the check runs locally AND on GitHub. (1) LOCAL: run the single check command in full once, in your own turn: cd tools && npm run check (six steps: format:check, lint, traces, handoffs-check, test, e2e). Record the command, the exit code, the duration of each step and the total, the tests passed/failed/skipped, the line e2e: browser=<version>, the e2e lines of the three spec files (smoke, pixel-office, picker) and the duration_ms of the e2e record. (2) GITHUB: build a snapshot commit of the work through a temporary index (GIT_INDEX_FILE; write-tree; commit-tree -p HEAD), never in the real index, with no checkout, reset, stash or clean. The snapshot holds the files of the run and leaves out the handoff of this step and every handoff whose status is not COMPLETED or FAILED (AP-141), and it leaves out docs/program/public-v1/PROGRESS.md (not a file of this run; it is never committed in runs). Before the push run handoffs-check and traces on the tree of the snapshot (a copy outside the project made with git archive of the snapshot commit) and push only when both are clean. Push it as <sha>:refs/heads/ci/e2e106-20261115-01-1 (the next number if that name is taken), find its check.yml run by the head sha, wait for it within your turn (about 15 minutes; the job timeout is 30 minutes, decisions/0106), read the conclusion, the job time, the image line, the e2e lines (browser, the three spec files, the record line with duration_ms) and the test counts from the log, then delete the branch and show it is gone. Write the list of files left out of the snapshot into self_check. (3) Analyse every failure with evidence; a failure is acceptable only if proven not caused by this work; a test that passes and fails by turns is a defect (say so, do not rerun until green). (4) Say how long the pixel-office spec took on the runner against the local 22 s, against the question line of 30000 ms (decisions/0112 О10; if it is longer, say so plainly: ORCH must ask the owner) and against the limit of 50000 ms of criterion 8; and the picker spec against its 80000 ms. (5) Check afterwards that no sai-e2e process and no sai-e2e temporary folder of yours is left, and that the working tree is as before your step (git status --short, sha256 of .git/index, sha256 over the run's files). Compare the local and the GitHub totals with the CI limit of 30 minutes (watch value about 25 minutes) and state the margin. PASS only if both runs are green or every failure is proven not caused by this work; otherwise FAIL. R2: no step of yours starts Pixel Office or its hook outside the spec; record sha256, size and time of the five files of the real Pixel Office state folder before and after your local run and say whether they changed (criterion 5). Do not edit the project (only this handoff), do not commit to any branch other than the temporary ci/ branch, do not push to main. The Mac has crashed under load before: one heavy job at a time.
